title.en: An Act Declaring May 6 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Pilar, Province of Sorsogon to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of Mayor Manuel T. Sia
title.orig: An Act Declaring May 6 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Pilar, Province of Sorsogon to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of Mayor Manuel T. Sia
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 6 tháng 5 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Pilar, Tỉnh Sorsogon, nhân kỷ niệm ngày mất của Mayor Manuel T. Sia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 6 พฤษภาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Pilar จังหวัด Sorsogon เนื่องในโอกาสครบรอบการถึงแก่อสัญกรรมของ Mayor Manuel T. Sia
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 6 Mei setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Pilar, Provinsi Sorsogon, dalam rangka memperingati hari wafat Mayor Manuel T. Sia
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 6 Mei setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Pilar, Wilayah Sorsogon, sempena memperingati hari kematian Mayor Manuel T. Sia

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9380_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To commemorate the death anniversary of Mayor Manuel T. Sia, Municipal Mayor of the Municipality of Pilar, Province of Sorsogon, May 6 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the said municipality.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
